Get involved

Careers

PictureThis Production is growing from a volunteer crew into a staffed organization as grant funding is confirmed. These are the roles we are hiring, in roughly the order funding unlocks them. One rule is stated plainly: a grant funded position exists only while its grant funds it, and we do not promise salaries ahead of funding. When a funded role opens, the people who expressed interest early are the first ones we call.

The first roles funded

Technical Director

Owns production standards, the equipment and the rig, technical training, and show delivery through Faithfire Production.

Program Coordinator

Runs the cohort program day to day: registration, scheduling, session logistics, and participant follow-up.

Bookkeeper / Finance Administrator (part time to start)

Keeps the books, payroll, and grant financial reporting in order, to funder audit standards.

Administrative Coordinator

Registration, scheduling, communications, and forms across the organization.

Roles that follow as funding grows

Executive Director

Overall leadership: funder relationships and reporting, strategy, and hiring.

Program Director or Program Manager

Owns the cohort program end to end: intake, curriculum, schedule, and outcomes.

Lead Instructor / Training Coordinator

Delivers the eight week training course and supervises practice sessions.

Mentorship Coordinator

Matches participants with working technicians and tracks each participant's progress.

Production Manager

Runs Faithfire services and events day to day: advancing shows, call sheets, and crew coordination.

Fundraising and Communications Officer

Grant writing, donor relations, and telling the story.

Youth summer staff (seasonal)

Summer program delivery roles for young people ages 15 to 30, funded through Canada Summer Jobs.

Sessional instructors and technicians

Specialists brought in per program or per show, on contract.

Express interest, with intent

Do not just send a CV. We want to hear intent. Write to rey.disse@picturethis-production.com and tell us, in your own words: the role or roles you are interested in; why you want this role, and why PictureThis; what you bring, the experience, skills, relationships, or lived experience you would carry into the role; and your availability (full time, part time, seasonal, or contract). A few honest paragraphs are worth more than a polished form letter. Attach a CV if you have one, but the letter is what we read first. There is no deadline; expressions of interest are kept on file and we contact people as each role is funded and opens.

Anyone whose role involves working with participants completes a Vulnerable Sector Check and follows our safeguarding policy and code of conduct.
